# Code of Conduct

This repository follows the estate's Contributor Covenant (1.4), as adopted in
`metadatastician/metadatastician-governance`. Enforcement, moderation and
appeals live there, not here; this file exists so `docs/`-presence and
required-files gates can resolve a Code of Conduct from inside the repository.

Reporting: use the contact in
[SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for safety issues, and the governance repository
for conduct issues.
